version.description: Override Graylog and Graylog Data Node version (optional)

nameOverride.description: Override the name of the chart. Affects app.kubernetes.io/name annotation

fullnameOverride.description: Override the fully qualified app name.

global.description: Values shared across the Graylog, Data Node, and MongoDB workloads.

imagePullSecrets.description: Image pull secret references used by all workloads to pull from private registries.

storageClass.description: Default StorageClass applied to PersistentVolumeClaims when a workload does not set its own.

existingSecretName.description: Name of existing Graylog secret containing GRAYLOG_MONGODB_URI, GRAYLOG_ROOT_USERNAME, GRAYLOG_PASSWORD_SECRET, and GRAYLOG_ROOT_PASSWORD_SHA2

enterprise.description: Use the Graylog Enterprise image and features. Set to false for Graylog Open.

replicas.description: Number of Graylog server replicas (StatefulSet pods).

service.description: Kubernetes Service exposing the Graylog server.

nameOverride.description: Override the generated name of the Graylog Service.

ports.description: Ports exposed by the Graylog Service.

app.description: Port for the Graylog web interface and REST API.

enabled.description: Expose the Prometheus metrics port on the Service.

inputs.description: Graylog input ports to open on the Service. This only exposes the port; it does not create the input in Graylog.

name.description: Name of the input port (used as the Service port name).

targetPort.description: Container port the input listens on.

protocol.description: Network protocol for the port (TCP or UDP).

plugins.description: Graylog plugins to install at startup. Each entry must provide exactly one source: image, existingClaim, or url.

name.description: Plugin name (used to label the plugin volume/artifact).

image.description: Container image that provides the plugin .jar (mounted via an init container).

existingClaim.description: Name of an existing PVC that contains the plugin .jar.

url.description: URL to download the plugin .jar from.

checksum.description: Expected checksum of the downloaded plugin, verified after download (requires url).

env.description: Key/value env vars rendered as literals

config.description: Graylog server configuration. These values can be found in server.conf

rootUsername.description: Username of the initial (root) Graylog admin user (server.conf: root_username).

rootPassword.description: Password for the initial admin user. Stored in the Graylog secret; leave empty to supply it via global.existingSecretName.

customSecretPepper.description: Secret used to salt/encrypt stored passwords (server.conf: password_secret). Auto-generated when empty; must be stable across all nodes.

timezone.description: Default timezone for the root user (server.conf: root_timezone), e.g. UTC or Europe/Berlin.

selfSignedStartup.description: Generate a self-signed certificate on startup when no TLS material is provided.

serverJavaOpts.description: JVM options for the Graylog server process (sets the base -Xms/-Xmx heap).

extraServerJavaOpts.description: Additional JVM options appended to the Graylog server command.

contentPacksAutoInstall.description: Automatically install bundled content packs on startup.

tls.description: TLS settings for the Graylog HTTP interface.

enabled.description: Enable TLS on the Graylog HTTP interface.

secretName.description: Name of the TLS Secret containing the certificate and private key.

keyPassword.description: Password protecting the private key, if any.

updateKeyStore.description: Import the provided certificate into the Java keystore on startup.

mongodb.description: MongoDB connection settings for the Graylog server.

customUri.description: Full MongoDB connection URI overriding the generated one (server.conf: mongodb_uri).

maxConnections.description: Maximum size of the MongoDB connection pool (server.conf: mongodb_max_connections).

versionProbeAttempts.description: Number of attempts to probe the MongoDB version on startup (0 = retry indefinitely; server.conf: mongodb_version_probe_attempts).

messageJournal.description: On-disk message journal settings buffering messages before processing.

enabled.description: Enable the on-disk message journal (server.conf: message_journal_enabled).

flushAge.description: Maximum age before journal data is flushed to disk (server.conf: message_journal_flush_age).

flushInterval.description: Number of messages written before the journal is flushed to disk (server.conf: message_journal_flush_interval).

maxAge.description: Maximum age of messages retained in the journal (server.conf: message_journal_max_age).

segmentAge.description: Maximum age of a journal segment before a new one is created (server.conf: message_journal_segment_age).

segmentSize.description: Maximum size of a journal segment before a new one is created (server.conf: message_journal_segment_size).

network.description: HTTP interface network settings for the Graylog server.

connectTimeout.description: HTTP client connect timeout, e.g. "5s" (server.conf: http_connect_timeout).

enableCors.description: Enable CORS headers on the HTTP interface (server.conf: http_enable_cors).

enableGzip.description: Enable gzip compression of HTTP responses (server.conf: http_enable_gzip).

maxHeaderSize.description: Maximum size of an HTTP request header in bytes (server.conf: http_max_header_size).

readTimeout.description: HTTP client read timeout, e.g. "10s" (server.conf: http_read_timeout).

threadPoolSize.description: Size of the HTTP worker thread pool (server.conf: http_thread_pool_size).

externalUri.description: Public URI clients use to reach the Graylog web interface/API (server.conf: http_external_uri).

performance.description: Processing and output performance tuning for the Graylog server.

asyncEventbusProcessors.description: Number of threads dedicated to dispatching internal events (server.conf: async_eventbus_processors).

inputBufferProcessors.description: Number of input buffer processor threads (server.conf: inputbuffer_processors).

inputBufferRingSize.description: Size of the input buffer ring; must be a power of two (server.conf: inputbuffer_ring_size).

inputBufferWaitStrategy.description: Disruptor wait strategy for the input buffer (server.conf: inputbuffer_wait_strategy).

jobSchedulerConcurrencyLimits.description: Concurrency limits for the job scheduler. Empty uses the Graylog default.

outputBatchSize.description: Maximum number of messages written to the search backend in a single batch (server.conf: output_batch_size).

outputFaultCountThreshold.description: Number of faults an output may accumulate before it is paused (server.conf: output_fault_count_threshold).

outputFaultPenaltySeconds.description: Seconds to wait before retrying an output that hit the fault threshold (server.conf: output_fault_penalty_seconds).

outputFlushInterval.description: Maximum seconds between two batches written to the search backend (server.conf: output_flush_interval).

outputBufferProcessorThreadsCorePoolSize.description: Core pool size for output buffer processor threads (server.conf: outputbuffer_processor_threads_core_pool_size).

outputBufferProcessors.description: Number of output buffer processor threads (server.conf: outputbuffer_processors). Empty uses the Graylog default.

processBufferProcessors.description: Number of process buffer processor threads (server.conf: processbuffer_processors). Empty uses the Graylog default.

email.description: Outbound email (SMTP) transport settings for notifications.

senderAddress.description: From address for emails sent by Graylog (server.conf: transport_email_from_email).

useAuth.description: Authenticate against the SMTP server (server.conf: transport_email_use_auth).

useSsl.description: Connect to the SMTP server using SSL (server.conf: transport_email_use_ssl).

useTls.description: Use STARTTLS when connecting to the SMTP server (server.conf: transport_email_use_tls).

webInterfaceUrl.description: Base URL of the Graylog web interface used in email links (server.conf: transport_email_web_interface_url).

enabled.description: Enable the Graylog plugin system (mount the plugins volume and load installed plugins).
Enable the MaxMind GeoIP update CronJob.

accountId.description: MaxMind account ID used to download databases.

licenseKey.description: MaxMind license key used to download databases.

cronSchedule.description: Cron schedule for periodic GeoIP database updates.

postInstallRun.description: Run a database download immediately after install via a post-install Helm hook Job.

mmdbSources.description: Sources for the initial geolocation database asset fetch.

url.description: GeoLite2-City.mmdb URL (only used for the initial asset fetch).

checksum.description: GeoLite2-City.mmdb checksum (only used for the initial asset fetch).

url.description: GeoLite2-ASN.mmdb URL (only used for the initial asset fetch).

checksum.description: GeoLite2-ASN.mmdb checksum (only used for the initial asset fetch).

init.description: Init-container behavior for the Graylog server.

assetFetch.description: Fetching of assets (plugins and geolocation databases) during init.

skipChecksum.description: Skip checksum verification of fetched assets.

allowHttp.description: Allow fetching assets over plain HTTP.

baseUrl.description: Base URL to fetch plugin assets from.
Base URL to fetch geolocation databases from.

repository.description: Image repository. Leave empty to use the chart default for the selected edition.

tag.description: Image tag. Leave empty to use the chart appVersion / .Values.version.

imagePullSecrets.description: Image pull secret references for the Graylog server image.

updateStrategy.description: StatefulSet update strategy for the Graylog server.

maxUnavailable.description: Maximum number of pods that can be unavailable during the update.

partition.description: Ordinal at which to partition the rolling update; pods with a lower ordinal are not updated.

resources.description: Compute resource requests and limits for the Graylog server container.

persistence.description: Persistent storage for the Graylog server.

enabled.description: Use a PersistentVolumeClaim for Graylog data. If false, an emptyDir is used.

storageClass.description: StorageClass for the PVC. Falls back to global.storageClass when unset.

volumeNameOverride.description: Bind the PVC to a specific PersistentVolume by name.

existingClaim.description: Use an existing PVC instead of creating one.

mountPath.description: Path where the volume is mounted in the container.

selector.description: Label selector used to bind the PVC to a matching PersistentVolume.

livenessProbe.description: Liveness probe for the Graylog server container.

initialDelaySeconds.description: Seconds to wait after container start before the first probe.

periodSeconds.description: How often (in seconds) to perform the probe.

timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds after which the probe times out.

failureThreshold.description: Consecutive failures before the probe is considered failed.

successThreshold.description: Consecutive successes before the probe is considered successful.

readinessProbe.description: Readiness probe for the Graylog server container.

initialDelaySeconds.description: Seconds to wait after container start before the first probe.

periodSeconds.description: How often (in seconds) to perform the probe.

timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds after which the probe times out.

failureThreshold.description: Consecutive failures before the probe is considered failed.

successThreshold.description: Consecutive successes before the probe is considered successful.

minAvailable.description: Minimum number of pods that must remain available during voluntary disruptions.

podSecurityContext.description: Pod-level securityContext for the Graylog StatefulSet. Set to null to omit it entirely ({} is coalesced back to the chart defaults).

initContainerSecurityContext.description: Container securityContext applied to the Graylog init containers. Set to null to omit it entirely ({} is coalesced back to the chart defaults).

containerSecurityContext.description: Container securityContext applied to the graylog-app container. Set to null to omit it entirely ({} is coalesced back to the chart defaults).

podAnnotations.description: Annotations added to the Graylog server pods.

nodeSelector.description: Node selector for scheduling the Graylog server pods.

tolerations.description: Tolerations for scheduling the Graylog server pods.

affinity.description: Affinity rules for scheduling the Graylog server pods.

enabled.description: Deploy the Graylog Data Node StatefulSet.

replicas.description: Number of Data Node replicas (StatefulSet pods).

service.description: Kubernetes Service exposing the Data Node.

ports.description: Ports exposed by the Data Node Service.

env.description: Key/value env vars rendered as literals

config.description: Graylog Data Node configuration (rendered into datanode.conf).

nodeIdFile.description: Path to the file storing the Data Node's node ID (datanode.conf: node_id_file). Defaults to /var/lib/graylog-datanode/node-id when empty.

opensearchHeap.description: Heap size for the embedded OpenSearch process, e.g. "2g" (datanode.conf: opensearch_heap).

javaOpts.description: JVM options for the Data Node process itself (sets -Xms/-Xmx heap).

skipPreflightChecks.description: Skip Data Node preflight checks on startup (datanode.conf: skip_preflight_checks).

nodeSearchCacheSize.description: Size of the OpenSearch search cache used for tiered/remote data, e.g. "10gb" (datanode.conf: node_search_cache_size).

s3ClientDefaultSecretKey.description: Secret key for the default S3 client used by data tiering/snapshots (datanode.conf: s3_client_default_secret_key). Stored in a Secret.

s3ClientDefaultAccessKey.description: Access key for the default S3 client used by data tiering/snapshots (datanode.conf: s3_client_default_access_key). Stored in a Secret.

s3ClientDefaultEndpoint.description: Endpoint for the default S3 client, e.g. an S3-compatible host (datanode.conf: s3_client_default_endpoint).

s3ClientDefaultRegion.description: Region for the default S3 client (datanode.conf: s3_client_default_region).

s3ClientDefaultProtocol.description: Protocol used to reach the S3 endpoint (datanode.conf: s3_client_default_protocol).

s3ClientDefaultPathStyleAccess.description: Use path-style access for the S3 client; required by some S3-compatible stores (datanode.conf: s3_client_default_path_style_access).

serviceAccount.description: ServiceAccount used by the Graylog server, with an optional RBAC Role.
